# Michigan Fall Color

> A live field guide to Michigan's fall color season. It tracks where the leaves are turning from canopy camera canopy data and Open-Meteo weather, shows a multi-day forecast by region, recommends where to go, and lists rivers to paddle through the color. Built and maintained by Chris Izworski, a Michigan outdoor writer.

Site: https://chrisizworski.com/fall-color

## When Michigan fall color peaks

Michigan color turns from north to south over about four weeks. Typical peak by region:

- Western Upper Peninsula (Porcupine Mountains, Keweenaw, Ontonagon): late September into the first week of October. The first color in the state.
- Eastern Upper Peninsula (Tahquamenon, Hiawatha, Whitefish Point): first to second week of October.
- Tip of the Mitt (Tunnel of Trees on M-119, Petoskey, Mackinaw): first to second week of October.
- Northwest Lower Michigan (Sleeping Bear Dunes, Traverse City, Leelanau): second to third week of October.
- Northeast Lower Michigan (Grayling, the Au Sable, Rifle River, Oscoda): second to third week of October.
- Central Michigan and Saginaw Bay (Bay City, Midland, Mount Pleasant): mid to late October.
- Southwest Lower Michigan (Grand Rapids, Saugatuck, Kalamazoo): third to fourth week of October.
- Southeast Lower Michigan (Detroit, Ann Arbor, Irish Hills): the last week of October, with oaks holding russet into November.

The last color is tamarack, a conifer that turns gold and drops its needles in northern bogs in early to mid November.

## How the live color is measured

- Canopy cameras: PhenoCam green chromatic coordinate at two anchor sites, used to shift the climatology curve when the year runs early or late
- Satellite (only when a recent composite exists): NASA MODIS 16 day NDVI canopy greenness, compared to each region's summer maximum to estimate how far the canopy has turned.
- Weather: Open-Meteo daily temperatures and frost dates, which pull the peak earlier after a run of cold nights.
- A regional climatology model sets the typical timing, and the live satellite and weather readings adjust it from there.
- A short daily color note is written through the season.

## Rivers to paddle through the color

- Au Sable River, the Holy Waters near Grayling.
- Pine River and Manistee River near Wellston and Mesick.
- Platte River and Crystal River near Sleeping Bear.
- Two Hearted River in the eastern Upper Peninsula.
- Huron River through Ann Arbor, the latest color of the year.

## Author

Chris Izworski is a Michigan angler and outdoor writer on Saginaw Bay who builds and maintains a family of Michigan field guides. Related work: Michigan Trout Report (https://michigantroutreport.com), Freighter View Farms (https://freighterviewfarms.com), and https://chrisizworski.com.
